verdict.rationale: Muse explicitly supports linking email and calendar (and other apps like Instagram/Facebook/finances) with approval-based permissions and audit trails, and can even write custom connectors for other services with APIs (muse-docs-11, muse-docs-23, muse-docs-28, muse-docs-14). However, cloud drive integration is never explicitly mentioned in any evidence, and there's no confirmation that search/retrieval across these connected sources works reliably for answering knowledge-worker queries specifically. missing for 10: explicit cloud-drive connector, evidence of search/retrieval quality across connected sources, independent corroboration of connector reliability.
